name: search_marketplace

query.description: Free text: a business name, a service or what the user needs (e.g. "sports massage")

city.description: City slug or name, e.g. "dublin" (searches a 20 km radius unless radiusKm is set)

near.description: Search around this point instead of a city

radiusKm.description: Search radius in km around city or near (1-200)

date.description: Only businesses with a free time on this date (YYYY-MM-DD, business timezone)

dealsOnly.description: Only businesses with an active deal (off-peak or last-minute discount)

cursor.description: nextCursor from a previous result, to get the next page

description: Search bookanything's marketplace of businesses in Ireland (physios, car washes, music teachers, GP practices, salons, fitness studios and more). Filter by free text, city or a point with a radius, category, a date with free times and deals. Results include each business's slug, distance, from-price, up to three next free times (with any deal price) and active deals. Use the slug with the other tools. Categories: physio, gp-practice, dental, salon, barber, massage, fitness, music-lessons, tutoring, car-wash, pet-grooming, other. Cities: dublin, cork, galway, limerick, waterford, kilkenny, sligo, athlone, drogheda, dundalk, wexford, killarney, tralee, ennis, letterkenny, bray, navan, carlow, mullingar, castlebar, clonmel, tullamore, naas, swords, portlaoise.
title: Search businesses

name: find_business

slug.description: The business's slug: the path of its page, e.g. "lumen-physio" for https://bookanything.ie/lumen-physio

description: A business's public profile by slug: name, description, address, contact details, timezone, currency, booking policies (notice, cancellation), customer groups, whether it takes online payments, and its booking page URL.
title: Find business

name: list_services

slug.description: The business's slug: the path of its page, e.g. "lumen-physio" for https://bookanything.ie/lumen-physio

description: The bookable services of a business: duration, price in minor units (cents), payment mode, options (choose one with optionId), add-ons, the selectable resource (e.g. a therapist) and the booking questions.
title: List services

name: check_availability

slug.description: The business's slug: the path of its page, e.g. "lumen-physio" for https://bookanything.ie/lumen-physio

optionId.description: Option id (required when the service has options)

resourceId.description: Selectable resource id, e.g. a specific therapist

after.description: Only times starting after this (ISO-8601 with offset); pass the last time you were shown to see later ones

description: Free start times for one service of a business between two dates (inclusive, at most 31 days; `to` defaults to `from`), in the business's timezone. Services with options need optionId. Slots with a deal carry `offer` with the discounted price. Pass groupId for restricted customer groups. Pass resourceId to choose a specific person (e.g. a therapist). Some businesses offer only their next available time: then the result has `nextAvailableOnly: true` and at most one time; call again with `after` set to that time to see the next one. A day the business hasn't opened for booking yet has no times and `opensAt` (when it opens), or `held: true` (not open yet, no time set).
title: Check availability
